reviews.text: Our dog Chop is a whole different dog after the 2 week dog boarding with Tony & Smart Start Puppies. He’s such a good dog & better behaved now. What a difference 🙏🏽 …

We did the 2 week board and train program for our 5 month old American bully puppy. It was a great experience and we are very pleased with the results. Our dog is more mature and listening to commands well. Tony and Julie are both a pleasure to work with and we look forward to continuing to work with them on all things related to our dogs behavior! Thank you so much, you have made owning our dog so much more enjoyable!!

To the whole team at Smart Start Puppies......we want to THANK YOU for your help in turning our dog Coco into a registered service animal!

Everyone on this team at Smart Start Puppies needs to be praised especially Tony, he was our main head trainer and coordinator.  We also had Chris assist in a few classes and it was great to be able to see how Coco responded to both trainers.

Coco was hyper, a leash puller, jumper and an all around unruly family dog.

Our daughter had a car accident and we decided to have Coco assist with mobility after her health care advisor suggested we try and have a dog to assist her in different mobility measures. Tony came up with a treatment plan for our family, and our dog, and we went to work. Coco did fantastic, we were the ones that needed the training...lol

Tony was patient and directed us every step of the way. We provided Smart Start Puppies with a letter from our dogs physician and they did the rest. You guys made us all feel comfortable, at ease and helped us see light at the end of the tunnel! THANK YOU FOR ALL YOUR SUPPORT AND GUIDANCE WITH OUR COCO!!!!!

In response to owners reply:
That was never disclosed and I was told the doctor was your in house doctor. Tony literally told me multiple times the doctor was going to give me a letter. In any case you took my money for 10 classes with service dog training and I never received 10 classes nor service dog paperwork. Why have I not received the refunded difference for the services I’ve actually received? Tony agreed to this, I have text thread and still have yet to hear anything back.

I originally bought the service dog package, was told there would be 10 training classes, an onsite therapist who would help with the service dog letter and airport training. I received 4 trainings, some at home and some at the airport, was told I had to pay for the therapist visit separately and they were not actually affiliated. I spoke to Tony the owner who initially said he would refund the difference, called and texted him after multiple attempts and have been ignored. Submitted a complaint through BBB and still have not received anything. Highly frustrating and disappointing- this business is a scam.
Great dog training company! I was able to train my dog Auto to come on flights with me and he’s so obedient now!

The difference in my Roxy’s behavior is like night and day. Tony and Lucas have done a wonderful job helping us with her training! She’s young and big so we were worried that she’d be too much of a handful with my young nephews, but after a couple classes I wasn’t worried in the least. She went from being distracted and hard to guide to a polite good girl that’s eager to please and play. I’d happily recommend anyone take this class if you know your pup is a good boy/gurl and just needs the guidance to show it. We aren’t even finished with her classes yet and she’s already been doing amazing. I know I don’t have to worry about her behavior anymore because she know what’s expected and follows through. They’ve done a great job with her!

My experience has been amazing. I reached out to Tony after being overwhelmed from trying to train my two golden doodle puppies on my own, one of which was very reactive. I sent her off to puppy boarding and training and am now doing at home training with both and the difference in their behavior is night and day. The puppies are so much better behaved and on their way to becoming the best companions I could ask for. Thank you Smart Puppies!!

Couldn’t be anymore satisfied with how Smart Start Puppies trained my dog Tank. They showed him the steps on how to be the best boy ever and corrected him for the better. Very attentive and not everything was money to the staff. They wanted to make sure the dog actually began learning and took their time with Tank. Overall amazing experience and highly recommend them for any future training.

I can’t say enough good things about Smart Start Puppies. Our red Lab, Atlas, just came home after 8 weeks of in-house training followed by a 2.5-week board-and-train, and the difference is night and day. He came back confident, responsive, and genuinely happy—you can tell he was loved and worked with every single day, not just managed.

What really set this experience apart was Tony. Not only did he do incredible work with Atlas, he personally flew him all the way up to Boston to deliver him to us. Who does that? It speaks volumes about how much this team cares about their dogs and their families. The communication throughout was excellent, and we always felt like Atlas was in the best possible hands.

Atlas also had a phenomenal time being boarded at Arfington Pet Resort. He clearly had room to play, socialize, and just be a happy puppy between training sessions—he came back well-adjusted and not the least bit stressed.

If you’re on the fence about board-and-train, this is the place. Tony and the whole Smart Start team gave us a dog we can actually enjoy living with, and they did it with a level of care and professionalism that’s rare to find. Thank you for everything!

I couldn’t thank Smart Start puppy dog training enough for their dedication professionalism and just overall quality. I found one of their promotions online and I call and someone immediately reached out to me went over the different programs. I had a major issue with my boxer leash control just not obey the basic commands. Now I have the dog of my dreams his name is lucky, but I am the one that truly is lucky that I get to enjoy my dog to the fullest

Smart Puppies is amazing. This is my second time using them for training and Tony is an amazing trainer. He not only educates the dog but he also spends time educating the owners.
A properly trained dog makes an amazing companion. It’s truly an investment not an expense.
I unequivocally recommend them to train your best friend.

Incredible experience.
Professional, patient, and truly cares about the dogs. I’ve seen a huge transformation in my dog behavior more calm, more confident, and better behaved overall.

Tony was the most enthusiastic, patient, helpful and highly educated with regards to training my dog    He explained everything thoroughly and clearly. My dog in one week was sleeping through the night, was eating her meals in her crate, showed me how to get her to stop biting.  Just yo name a few.  All in one week.  He really is incredible at his job.    I would highly recommend him or his company
AMAZING!🐶

The experience with this company was really great. The trainer was patient and trained my Great Dane well. Gave me advice on how to handle her while he was not around and was always attentive with my concerns. Definitely recommend

Thank you smart start puppies again and again…..My dog Lola was a mess, from the start to the finish Smart Start Puppies and its team directed me and my family on how to get our dream dog!

Every time I called them they were there, every time I needed help with Lola one of their team members helped and the care and love they had with Lola was un matched. I had hired one other company before Smart Start Puppies and let’s just say it was NOTHING like this organization.

Don’t waste your time looking at any other company, Smart Start Puppies is very reasonably priced for the service and results you get. Thank you again for all your help with Lola!!!!!
Wonderful training, perfect attitude and dedication!!!
Great service! Thanks for everything

We couldn’t be happier with Smart Step Puppies and our trainer Tony! From puppy obedience to ongoing lifestyle training, the difference in our dog has been amazing. Tony’s patience, skill, and genuine care have transformed our pup into a well-behaved, confident, and happy dog. The training is practical, consistent, and truly fits into everyday life. Highly recommend Smart Step Puppies and Tony to anyone who wants the best for their dog! 🐾

After 2 months with my new rescue, I knew we needed some help. A great dog, a lot of trauma. We had to start from the basics. She needed to learn how to just be a dog. She had no idea.  Tony and Julie have been the best.  From the house, to the neighborhood, to day boarding to the airport and mall visits, they were always there to help guide Scout and I.  With the consistency learned in training I now have a happy, stress free home and a well adjusted dog 6 months post adoption.  Time and money well spent.

I can’t say enough good things about Tony as a dog trainer. From day one, he’s been patient, professional, and genuinely invested in helping Ollie (and me!) succeed. You can tell he truly understands dog behavior and meets each dog where they’re at, no cookie-cutter methods, just tailored guidance that actually works.

Ollie not only responded well to Tony’s techniques but actually enjoyed the training process. Tony helped build Ollie’s confidence while giving me the tools I needed to feel more confident as a dog owner. Whether we were working on leash manners, commands, or addressing anxiety, Tony always made it feel manageable and encouraging.

He has a calm, grounded energy that dogs pick up on immediately and that energy carries over to the people he works with too. If you’re looking for someone who’s kind, consistent, and really knows what they’re doing, Tony is the one. I’m grateful we found him.
Great training! Tony is doing a great job and our dog is way more obedient with every command!

I am surprised to see the change in Bruno. I thought there was no solution for my dog's behavior. I was very frustrated because he is already 4 years old and he had not changed. Before, I could not go out for a walk with him because he was very disobedient, he did not socialize with other dogs or cats, he did not like boys, and he would jump in front of cars. I had already paid 3 dog trainers and it was of no use. Fortunately, I met Tony, the owner of Smart Puppies Training, and only with the second class did I see the great change in Bruno. Now I can go out with Bruno and I see the change and I can enjoy it. I can open the door to my house and Bruno is already waiting for me to say "let's go." He still needs 3 more classes to finish his behavior correction training. I am definitely happy. I highly recommend him.

***THE BEST** we were so lucky to find Tony the dog trainer. We have had previous dog trainers and never had success. I was so please to see our dog Toby's success with the training sessions. Now Toby is able to fly with us and we are so happy!!!

The Smart Start Puppies team have completely transformed our lives with their hard work and knowledge. They didn’t change our dog Sasha, but brought out the obedient dog she can be, whilst also improving her social skills. Sasha’s demeanour …

The training we had with our golden retriever, Cooper is his name, was unbelievable! He came back a totally different dog!! Highly recommend Smart Start Puppies for your loved pooch! By the way the photo of Cooper in our front yard just lounging without a collar and just enjoying the morning:
